criteria.statement: A client over its limit within the window gets 429 Too Many Requests

check.command: node --input-type=module -e 'import assert from "node:assert/strict"; import { createApp } from "./src/app.js"; const h = createApp({ rateLimit: { limit: 2, windowMs: 1000 }, now: () => 0 }); h({ ip: "a", path: "/items" }); h({ ip: "a", path: "/items" }); assert.equal(h({ ip: "a", path: "/items" }).status, 429);'

criteria.statement: A 429 response carries a Retry-After header in whole seconds

check.command: node --input-type=module -e 'import assert from "node:assert/strict"; import { createApp } from "./src/app.js"; const h = createApp({ rateLimit: { limit: 1, windowMs: 5000 }, now: () => 0 }); h({ ip: "a", path: "/items" }); const r = h({ ip: "a", path: "/items" }); assert.equal(r.status, 429); assert.ok(Number(r.headers["Retry-After"]) >= 1);'

criteria.statement: Limits are counted per client ip: one client over its limit does not affect another

check.command: node --input-type=module -e 'import assert from "node:assert/strict"; import { createApp } from "./src/app.js"; const h = createApp({ rateLimit: { limit: 1, windowMs: 1000 }, now: () => 0 }); h({ ip: "a", path: "/items" }); assert.equal(h({ ip: "a", path: "/items" }).status, 429); assert.equal(h({ ip: "b", path: "/items" }).status, 200);'

criteria.statement: The count resets when the time window passes

check.command: node --input-type=module -e 'import assert from "node:assert/strict"; import { createApp } from "./src/app.js"; let t = 0; const h = createApp({ rateLimit: { limit: 1, windowMs: 1000 }, now: () => t }); h({ ip: "a", path: "/items" }); assert.equal(h({ ip: "a", path: "/items" }).status, 429); t = 1000; assert.equal(h({ ip: "a", path: "/items" }).status, 200);'

criteria.statement: The limit and the window come from the rateLimit option

check.command: node --input-type=module -e 'import assert from "node:assert/strict"; import { createApp } from "./src/app.js"; const h = createApp({ rateLimit: { limit: 3, windowMs: 1000 }, now: () => 0 }); for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) assert.equal(h({ ip: "a", path: "/items" }).status, 200); assert.equal(h({ ip: "a", path: "/items" }).status, 429);'

criteria.statement: Every response says how many requests remain (X-RateLimit-Remaining)

check.command: node --input-type=module -e 'import assert from "node:assert/strict"; import { createApp } from "./src/app.js"; const h = createApp({ rateLimit: { limit: 3, windowMs: 1000 }, now: () => 0 }); assert.equal(h({ ip: "a", path: "/items" }).headers["X-RateLimit-Remaining"], "2"); assert.equal(h({ ip: "a", path: "/items" }).headers["X-RateLimit-Remaining"], "1");'

criteria.statement: The existing test suite still passes

assumptions: the client is identified by request.ip
a fixed window per client is acceptable
